option.mapsyncer.hash_threads.tooltip: Number of parallel threads used when computing region file hashes. Higher values may speed up sync but increase CPU usage.
option.mapsyncer.debug.tooltip: When enabled, detailed map generation debug information will be output to the log.
option.mapsyncer.concurrent_regions.tool: Maximum number of regions converted simultaneously. Higher values process faster but demand more server CPU.
option.mapsyncer.packet_size.tooltip: Maximum bytes per network packet during sync. Excessively large packets may be dropped on unstable connections.
option.mapsyncer.speed_limit.tooltip: Maximum transfer rate (KB/s) during sync. Set to 0 for unlimited. Too high may impact game network quality.
option.mapsyncer.update_mode.tooltip:
Server-side map cache incremental update strategy.

DISABLED - No incremental updates, also disables client auto-sync.
TICK - Periodic tick-based updates. Client auto-sync interval = max(tick_minutes, 60).
SCHEDULED - Daily scheduled update. Client auto-syncs every 24h.
option.mapsyncer.interval_ticks.tooltip: Update interval in TICK mode. 20 ticks = 1 second. Also determines the client auto-sync cooldown (max of tick interval in minutes and 60 minutes).
option.mapsyncer.scheduled_hour.tooltip: Hour of day (0-23) for incremental updates and auto-sync in SCHEDULED mode.
option.mapsyncer.scheduled_minute.toolti: Minute of hour (0-59) for incremental updates and auto-sync in SCHEDULED mode.
option.mapsyncer.client_sync_mode.toolti: Controls whether this client disables sync, only receives authoritative server map data, or also contributes newer local regions.
option.mapsyncer.background_sync_interva: Minutes between background metadata checks while connected. Set to 0 to disable periodic checks.
option.mapsyncer.contribution_scope.tool: Controls which players may upload newer local regions to the server cache. Keep WHITELIST for explicit per-world approval.
option.mapsyncer.contribution_cooldown.t: Seconds to wait between completed contribution sessions. This serializes bursts from multiple players.
option.mapsyncer.contribution_queue_size: Maximum number of contribution sessions waiting in the server queue before new requests are rejected.
